bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 60
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-media-diag-5bc91f)" || exit 61
logs="$(docker logs --since 90m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1)" || exit 62
if printf '%s' "$logs" | grep -Fq '[LINK_MEDIA_DOCUMENT_CLASSIFIED] MP4'; then exit 80; fi
if printf '%s' "$logs" | grep -Fq '[LINK_MEDIA_DOCUMENT_CLASSIFIED] OTHER'; then exit 81; fi
if printf '%s' "$logs" | grep -Fq 'LINK_MEDIA_STAGE_CHANGED'; then exit 82; fi
if printf '%s' "$logs" | grep -Fq 'LINK_MEDIA_UPDATE_NOT_CONFIRMED'; then exit 83; fi
exit 84
